# Kling 2.6 Motion Control API

> Apply motion from a source video to an image with Standard or Pro processing.

Apply motion from a source video to an image with Standard or Pro processing.

## Workflows

| Workflow | Endpoint |
| - | - |
| [Pro](https://docs.higgsfield.ai/docs/models/kling-2-6-motion-control/pro.md) | `POST /kling-video/motion-control/pro` |
| [Standard](https://docs.higgsfield.ai/docs/models/kling-2-6-motion-control/std.md) | `POST /kling-video/motion-control/std` |

Open a workflow to see its complete input schema, required fields, supported values and request examples.
